verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is thin: Stripe Billing offers a hosted customer portal where customers can manage their account, and a Stripe PM mentions credit card update notice emails, which are off by default. Neither item explicitly says the portal handles payment-method updates. Nothing documents automatic card refresh. missing for 10: network account updater (automatic card refresh), backup/fallback payment methods, explicit documentation that the hosted portal updates payment methods, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, expiring or replaced cards update themselves — network account updater, backup payment methods, and hosted update-payment pages

citations.quote: Give your customers the ability to manage their account by setting up a customer portal.
all customer emails (like credit card update notices) are off by default
